scope: Focused APK workflows in ARM64 Vinix QEMU using the preserved 3 October runtime plus the V framework extension; stack and memory probes retained.
full_runtime_note: The preserved base failed the newer fork ABI preflight on 20 October. The full preflight was not rerun here; use matching rebuilt overlays for full conformance.
display_backend: GTK through embedded X11 in the native Vinix desktop
outer_caption: The investigation uses the existing Android Calculator desktop entry for all three APKs.

host_checks.framework_transformation: PASS: lifecycle bodies preserved, static JNI factory, declaration guards, cursor constructors and launcher path
host_checks.runner_session: PASS: real PTY/QMP acknowledgements, shifted key, serial drain, screenshots, observation and failure cleanup
host_checks.native_library: ARM64 build passed -Wall -Wextra -Werror; LOAD alignment 65536; no V heap allocation imports
host_checks.calculator_input: Complete taps sent in a single QMP request, retaining per-character APK acknowledgements

applications.verification: Real QMP input and manual inspection of successive framebuffer captures; delayed callbacks and serial log checked after reopening.
steps: Choose Edit; Activity recreation retains edit mode.
Type Vinix Android APK test; word count becomes 4 words and 22 characters.
Open Save as; edit the actual filename field to Documents/Vinix.txt and press Save.
Choose New file; text clears and counts become 0 and 0.
Choose Open recent and Documents/Vinix.txt; a new Activity reads the saved document.
Observe the restored text, 4 words and 23 characters including the newline written by Editor; delayed scroll restoration completes without a JNI abort.

applications.verification: Real QMP pointer input and manual inspection of the board, saved list preview and reopened puzzle; serial checked for linkage/JNI failures.
steps: Dismiss the initial changelog dialog, open Easy and the first puzzle.
Dismiss the queued reusable hints and switch to Single number mode.
Select 7 and tap row 1, column 1; observe the inserted value.
Use Back; the list shows Playing 05:20 and a preview containing the new 7.
Reopen the first puzzle; row 1, column 1 still contains 7.
applications.coverage_limit: Single number touch workflow; popup tabs, import/export and other advanced operations are not covered.

applications.verification: Automated per-key acknowledgement and test-only observation of actual APK text; the observer performs no calculation.
